Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape set, a card part. It builds on `main` behind R1420's gate, so no player meets these cards before the release, the last part of #1856.

## Scope

- **Cards**: `#4` Olivian Expanse, `#4.1` Farewell, `#4.2` KY's Last Exam, `#4.3` Event Horizon, `#4.4` Last Word, `#4.5` 1v1 Final Destination, `#4.6` The Big Crunch, `#154` Dice of Doom
- **Uses, already on `main`**: #1837, #1842

1v1 Final Destination reveals when your opponent's turn ends, so you strike first at 1 health (the designer asked the build to infer its reveal). Each card's entry is in the foundation's card-by-card brief (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` once #1857 has merged); the designer's words are `JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`. The plan's fixes (ST8) and the designer's answers (ST9) win over the designer's words.
